curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain who yields at intersections, on left turns and when entering roads.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on the First Car Rule, the Same Time Rule and entering traffic.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario items on who goes first.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover each steady and flashing signal and right turn on red.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each signal's meaning and the right-on-red steps.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items that separate steady and flashing yellow and red.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain what warning signs do and how they look.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on purpose, shape, color and pictured examples.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on warning sign color and shape.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk through railroad signs and how to cross tracks safely.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on each railroad sign and crossing procedure.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on stopping points and what to do if stuck.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain work zone signs, flaggers, barriers and temporary signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards on sign color, flaggers and barriers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Items on following flaggers and reading work zone signs.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec07-m01..sec07-m05; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Rules of the road: right-of-way, traffic signals, warning signs, railroad crossings and work zone signs

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
